speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You have a fever and altered mentation that started two days ago; to begin our assessment, are you currently experiencing any headache, neck stiffness, or sensitivity to light?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of fever and altered mentation, reporting fever without chills and rigors. He denies sore throat, abdominal pain, headache, loose stool, burning micturition, or seizures. Has a history of tics and is currently taking haloperidol.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS)

I have noted your history of tics and current use of haloperidol, which puts you at risk for NMS, especially given your fever and altered mental status without headache or neck stiffness. Do you notice any muscle rigidity or stiffness in your body, and have you had any recent changes in your medication dosage?
